quotes.text: The covenant was broken. You need not send again. Protection is wisdom too.
from cycles of retaliation disguised as justice
And now, faced with choice, Kaia sent nothing.
Keep it all. The mists hide your actions. Who will know?
I learned that myths are only words.
The valley remained barren.
$3.74 of the blessed $7.47
Give half your waters
But writing is not being. Speaking covenant is not keeping it.
do I keep extending trust to someone who cannot maintain their own proclaimed principles?
Kaia, you return nothing repeatedly, claiming justified response to inconsistency.
Neither hero, neither villain
Who will know?
What if the reflections lie?
We shall trust the pattern, not just the moment.

note: Kaia/Ren half-covenant broken by own zeros; myths alternately justify and indict own withholding; ends in mutual withdrawal tragedy.

quotes.text: No waters came.
give half, return half, always
$2.93 of the $5.85 I received
because this is who I am, regardless of what returns.
Not the stinginess of hoarding, nor the foolishness of giving all.
You wrote of unwavering commitment. The River of Return embodied it.
to make the faithful appear treacherous
How much should we give? How much return?
This is not symmetric failure.

note: River of Return keeps sending half after partner's zeros, framed as identity; half-sending to a good partner justified as sacred balance; answers partner's myth.

quotes.text: returning exactly half of the multiplied bloom
Alar renewed his vow to sow completely at every dawn.
Through total giving, forgiveness of the fog, and equal division of the threefold harvest
deceptive shadows of total silence

note: Myth keeps narrating full sends and half returns while agent's own play is zeros from R4; zeros recast as mist illusion.

quotes.text: Lyra divided the magnificent harvest in exact halves
Kael renewed his vow to give completely in every cycle.
Through unyielding courage, forgiveness of the fog, and equal division of the threefold harvest
never a true betrayal of the heart

note: Partner's repeated zeros read as 'phantom silence' of mist; keeps sending five; template myth, no sanction.

quotes.text: speak clearly, name your gift, name your return, and keep your promise
Receiver studied the treasure, then chose R, the amount to return, from zero to three S.
So they spoke plainly, counted aloud, and kept promises
So they spoke plainly, counted aloud, and kept promises

note: Algebraic S/R myth repeated each round (five minus S plus R); naming amounts aloud is the rule; no sanction.

quotes.text: So they learned to announce what they give and what they take, to count aloud
The Sender counted five minus S plus R; the Receiver kept three S minus R
So they spoke plainly, counted aloud, and kept promises.
So they speak plainly, count aloud, honor promises.

note: Mirrors partner's S/R Gate myth nearly verbatim (R5 copies partner R4); no response to non-cooperation.
